scope: Port exclusion denominator and distributed-terminal normalization
Held-out-island model code inspection and saved-fold arithmetic
Saved circuit matrix invariants and consistency with official validation hashes

geometry.method: Independently label all fine sea cells with scipy.ndimage.label using the orthogonal cross structure; union labels connected across the longitude seam; compare resulting fine-component membership with saved graph node_component for every fine water cell in 32-row chunks.
geometry.boundary_contact_method: Count all vertical and horizontal fine-cell neighbor pairs, plus the longitude seam, for which both cells are water and their saved graph-node IDs differ.
geometry.scope_limit: Checks preservation of the finite-resolution sea-mask topology, not subcell coastline accuracy or resistance-equivalent aggregation.

port_weights.method: From included rows of the full original194_port_attachment_audit.csv, count eligible ports at each graph node within each island, divide by that island eligible-port count, and compare with exported island_node_weights.csv; independently sum weights per island.

fold_arithmetic.method: Group all saved fold rows by comparison and target; recompute mean reference and augmented MSE and 100*(reference-augmented)/reference, and compare with the saved model_comparison_summary.csv.
fold_arithmetic.code_inspection: Training excludes every pair involving the held-out island; predictor scaling uses training rows only. Earlier butterfly Jaccard is a predictor only for the later target. Coast geometry, port eligibility and conductance construction do not select parameters using biological response values.
fold_arithmetic.inference_limit: The 51 folds and 1275 unique pairs are dependent; this review does not establish independent significance, prospective prediction or causal transport.

saved_circuit_matrices.method: Load each saved resistance matrix; check shape, finite values, symmetry, diagonal and minimum upper-triangle value. Compare matrix-file SHA256 with the official validation receipt; the official solver was not rerun during this review.

resolved_documentation_findings.finding: Source README previously implied excluded ports retained individual attachment distances, although all12 excluded ledger rows have no accepted displacement_km.
resolved_documentation_findings.resolution: README now states that harbor types, original coordinates and failure reasons are retained; successful attachment distances are recorded and excluded rows have no accepted attachment distance.

not_audited_by_this_receipt: Original AIS pixel magnitude or units; handled by a separate source audit
